# ukdatakit

> ukdatakit makes pay-per-result tools for official UK public data, available on the Apify Store. Results export to JSON, CSV or Excel, or by API. Pricing is per result and shown on Apify.

## Tools

- [UK House Prices](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-house-prices): sold house prices from HM Land Registry Price Paid Data by full postcode, sector or outcode, with date filters and a run summary including the median price. One row per sale: price, date, full address, postcode, property type, new build, tenure, transaction category and a link to the Land Registry record.
- [UK Visa Sponsor Register](https://ukdatakit.com/#uk-visa-sponsor-register): search the Home Office register of licensed sponsors by organisation name, town and route; check whether an employer can sponsor Skilled Worker visas. One row per sponsor: name, town, county, routes, types and ratings, Skilled Worker flag, register date and a link to the GOV.UK CSV.

## Other

- [Custom data jobs](https://ukdatakit.com/#custom): tailored feeds from official UK open data. Contact hello@ukdatakit.com.
- Data licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (Crown copyright).
